curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain who shares the road and why pedestrians face the most danger, then the rules for walkers, blind travelers, turning, backing, crosswalks and school buses.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each pedestrian rule; a contrast card on crosswalk priority and frozen passing.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a pedestrian situation and asking what the driver must do.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover how drivers share space with cyclists, where cyclists ride, helmets and passengers, required equipment and lights, and turning and passing near cyclists.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for cyclist rules and driver duties; contrast cards on lane position and the night-light distances.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on cyclist rules and how drivers pass or turn near them.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain due care for skaters and scooters, then why motorcycles are hard to see, how they use the lane, what hides their signals, where crashes happen and road hazards for riders.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each motorcycle visibility and hazard point; contrast cards on lane sharing and the left-turn danger.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on why motorcycles are missed and how to drive around them.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Separate the three moped classes by speed, license and lane rules, then explain where mopeds ride and why large trucks have big blind spots.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for moped classes and lane rules and truck blind spots; contrast cards on the three classes and their lane limits.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a moped's top speed and asking its class and rules.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover truck blind spots, stopping and turning, passing and backing trucks, then slow-moving vehicles, all-terrain vehicles and snowmobiles, horses, and the chapter's review topics.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each truck rule and for slow vehicles and horses; a contrast card on truck front and rear blind spots.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on driving near trucks and slow vehicles.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec11-m01..sec11-m05; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
